- **iCloud review you can actually use (FL-1749):** open a photo to see the iCloud copy beside the one in your library, why it needs a look, only the details that differ, and exactly what Accept and Later do. Photos already in your library link by themselves instead of waiting for review, and the rest show a thumbnail.
- **Locked photos stay private on every screen (FL-1767):** when a photo moves into Locked, only your unlocked sessions see it; your other open windows and devices drop it straight away. Links a former album member made stop working once they leave.
- **Signing out tells the truth (FL-1771):** if the server can't end your session, Frameleaf keeps you signed in and says so, instead of looking signed out until the next page load. A removed licence takes the supporter badge away.
- **Imports and libraries (FL-1768, FL-1772):** an unmounted media folder no longer makes your originals look lost, hostile import sources are refused, and library scans and the media sandbox are safer.
- **Smart search and faces (FL-1773, FL-1774, FL-1775, and the search model staging fix):** custom search models are checked for size before they download, missing search models are fetched when needed, and face models keep working after an update.
- **Payments, backups and Manager (FL-1769, FL-1770):** a payment event that keeps failing no longer holds back newer payments, and Manager's operations, backups and install checks are sturdier.
- **Everyday fixes (FL-1776, FL-1777):** partner copies are counted once and finished items are no longer queued again, and the enrichment job has a clearer name.
- **Behind the scenes (FL-1765, FL-1766):** the database image is based on the official PostgreSQL 19.0, and publishing images resumes after a hiccup.
